t.zh: 有时候不用知道有几条路线，只想知道能不能到。这时格子里不用存数，存「是」或「否」就够了。
t.en: Sometimes you don’t need to know how many routes there are, only whether you can get there at all. Then the cells don’t need to hold numbers: “yes” or “no” is enough.

t.zh: 新元件：「任一是」汇合器。接进来的信号里只要有一个「是」，它就输出「是」。到一个路口，上面或左边只要有一边能到，这里就能到。
t.en: A new component: the “any yes” Merger. If any signal wired into it is “yes”, it outputs “yes”. At a crossing, if either up or left can be reached, so can this one.

t.zh: 起点本身当然能到。石头格呢？拦截闸现在也能拦「是 / 否」：被拦下的格子写「—」，「任一是」不会把它当成「是」。
t.en: The start can of course be reached. What about rock cells? The Block gate can now block “yes / no” too: a blocked cell gets “—”, and “any yes” won’t count it as a “yes”.

goal.zh: 只能往右或往下走，不能经过石头。每个格子写上「是」或「否」：从起点能不能走到这里（石头格写「—」）。
goal.en: Only right or down, and never through a rock. Write “yes” or “no” in every cell: can you get here from the start? (Rock cells get “—”.)

how.zh: 这一关会检查整张表。读上面、左边和「是起点」，用「任一是」汇合器合起来，别忘了石头。
how.en: This level checks the whole table. Read up, left and “is start”, merge them with an “any yes” Merger, and don’t forget the rocks.

hints.zh: 到这一格，只要上面或左边有一边能到就行：把上面、左边都接进「任一是」汇合器。
hints.en: This cell can be reached if either up or left can: wire both up and left into an “any yes” Merger.

hints.zh: 起点能到：把「是起点」也接进「任一是」。
hints.en: The start can be reached: wire “is start” into “any yes” too.

hints.zh: 石头格谁也到不了：用拦截闸拦住结果，条件接「是石头」。
hints.en: Nobody can reach a rock cell: block the result with a Block gate, its condition wired to “is rock”.

title.en: Yes or no fills a table too

body.zh: 格子里不一定要存数。存「是 / 否」，表就能回答「能不能」一类的问题。
body.en: Cells don’t have to hold numbers. Store “yes / no” and the table can answer “can it be done?” questions.

body.zh: 合并方式也跟着换：数路线要加起来，问能不能到，只要有一个「是」就够，所以用「任一是」。第 2 个测试里，一排石头把路彻底堵死了，终点是「否」。
body.en: The way of merging changes with it: counting routes means adding up, but for “can you get there” a single “yes” is enough, so you use “any yes”. In test 2, a line of rocks blocks the way completely, and the end is “no”.

note.zh: 格子可以存「是 / 否」：任一来路能到，这里就能到。
note.en: Cells can hold “yes / no”: if any way in can be reached, so can this cell.
